overview: This page stores NPGC academics information for Centre for Vocational and Futuristic Studies. Captured source headings include: Centre for Vocational and Futuristic Studies, B.Voc. in Hotel Management, B.Voc. in Medical Lab Technology (MLT), B.Voc. in Operation Theatre Technology (OTT). Source page: https://www.npgc.in/Academics-CVFS.aspx
content:
B.Voc. in Hotel Management
Candidates must have passed 10+2 (Intermediate) in any stream (Arts/Science/Commerce) from a recognized board.
Minimum 45% aggregate marks required in the qualifying examination.
Curriculum strictly aligned with NEP 2020 & NSQF levels for skill-based education.
Front Office & Housekeeping Training Labs.
Advanced Commercial Kitchen & Bakery setup.
Mock Bar and Restaurant for Food & Beverage service drills.
Regular Guest Lectures by Industry Professionals.
Compulsory Industrial Training in 5-Star Hotels.
Soft Skills and Personality Development grooming.
Practical-heavy curriculum with 60% focus on hands-on skills.
Multiple Entry/Exit options (Diploma/Advanced Diploma/Degree).
Earn-while-you-learn opportunities during internships.
Job Roles: Hotel Manager, Front Office Executive, Executive Chef, Cabin Crew, Cruise Ship Staff.
Top Recruiters: Taj Group, Marriott, Oberoi Hotels, Indigo Airlines, ITC Hotels.
B.Voc. in Medical Lab Technology (MLT)
Candidates must have passed 10+2 (Intermediate) in any stream (Arts/Science/Commerce) from a recognized board.
Minimum 45% aggregate marks required in the qualifying examination.
Curriculum strictly aligned with NEP 2020 & NSQF levels for skill-based education.
Modern Pathology & Haematology Labs.
Training on High-end Biochemistry Analysers.
Tie-ups with Multi-specialty Hospitals for clinical rotation.
Workshops on Molecular Biology & Histopathology.
In-campus Digital Library with access to medical journals.
Direct clinical exposure from the first year.
Focus on diagnostic accuracy and laboratory safety standards.
Professional certification integrated with the degree.
Job Roles: Lab Technologist, R&D Assistant, Blood Bank Technician, Lab Manager.
Top Recruiters: Apollo Diagnostics, Dr. Lal Path Labs, Max Healthcare, Government Hospitals.
B.Voc. in Operation Theatre Technology (OTT)
Candidates must have passed 10+2 (Intermediate) in any stream (Arts/Science/Commerce) from a recognized board.
Minimum 45% aggregate marks required in the qualifying examination.
Curriculum strictly aligned with NEP 2020 & NSQF levels for skill-based education.
Mock Operation Theatre with standard surgical equipment.
Training in Anaesthesia assistance and sterilization protocols.
Hands-on experience in ICU and Emergency Care modules.
Specialized workshops on Surgical Instrumentation.
Collaboration with leading healthcare providers for internships.
High-demand technical role in the healthcare ecosystem.
Skills-based learning focusing on pre, intra, and post-operative care.
Training in life-saving procedures and advanced medical tech.
Job Roles: OT Technician, Anaesthesia Technician, CSSD Supervisor, Transplant Coordinator.
Top Recruiters: Medanta, Fortis, Sahara Hospital, Apollo, KGMU.
B.Voc. in Hospital Management
Candidates must have passed 10+2 (Intermediate) in any stream (Arts/Science/Commerce) from a recognized board.
Minimum 45% aggregate marks required in the qualifying examination.
Curriculum strictly aligned with NEP 2020 & NSQF levels for skill-based education.
Digital Classrooms with Hospital Information System (HIS) software.
Hospital visits for administrative workflow analysis.
Training in Medical Coding, Insurance, and TPA.
Seminar hall for National Healthcare Summits.
Case-study based learning for crisis management.
Bridge the gap between healthcare and business administration.
Focus on patient care quality and operational efficiency.
Includes 6 months of mandatory administrative internship.
Job Roles: Hospital Coordinator, Patient Relation Manager, Healthcare Administrator, HR in Healthcare.
Top Recruiters: UNICEF, WHO (Projects), Corporate Hospitals (Manipal, Max), Health Insurance Firms.
B.Voc. in Physiotherapy
Candidates must have passed 10+2 (Intermediate) in any stream (Arts/Science/Commerce) from a recognized board.
Minimum 45% aggregate marks required in the qualifying examination.
Curriculum strictly aligned with NEP 2020 & NSQF levels for skill-based education.
Well-equipped Kinesiology and Electrotherapy Lab.
Anatomy Models and Human Skeleton study room.
Practical training in Exercise Therapy and Sports Rehab.
Regular health camps for community outreach.
Expert-led sessions on Manual Therapy and Chiropractic techniques.
Focus on non-invasive healing and rehabilitative sciences.
Emphasis on sports medicine and geriatric care.
Integrated clinical practice with local clinics and hospitals.
Job Roles: Physiotherapist, Sports Rehab Specialist, Fitness Consultant, Ergonomics Advisor.
Top Recruiters: Sports Authorities, Rehabilitation Centres, Private Clinics, Nursing Homes.
